title: fix: throw on non-OK API responses to prevent page crash
body:
## Summary

`apiFetch` previously returned `response.json()` without checking `response.ok`. On a non-2xx response (e.g. a 401 from NocoDB), the error payload was returned as data, causing `data.list` to be `undefined` — which crashes the component when `.map()` is called on it, making the entire page disappear.

Now `apiFetch` checks `response.ok` and throws with the server's error message, so the Redux thunk properly rejects and the component renders the `"Error loading projects"` state instead of crashing.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/ac912ce6816b4c799b7044cdca62756c
